eeatSignals.detail: Authorship identification builds personal experience and topical authority.
Reachable customer service and verified contact methods.
Legal transparency and user data compliance.
Verifiable external claims and factual references.

issues.title: Suboptimal Title Length (14 characters)
issues.description: Your title is "Example Domain". Ideal length is 40–60 characters to prevent truncation on mobile and desktop Google SERPs.
issues.impact: Search engines may truncate your title or replace it with an automated guess.
issues.recommendation: Refine your title to approximately 50-60 characters including primary keyword and brand.

issues.title: Missing Meta Description
issues.description: No <meta name="description"> tag was discovered on the page.
issues.impact: Search engines generate random snippet text, reducing click-through rate.
issues.recommendation: Provide a compelling description summarizing page value in 130-160 characters.
issues.codeSnippet: <meta name="description" content="Discover actionable website audits across SEO, AEO, AIO, GEO, and E-E-A-T dimensions with CrawlLens.">

issues.title: No <h1> Heading Found
issues.description: The page lacks a primary H1 heading to establish topic semantics.
issues.impact: Weakens content structure signals for both Google and AI search agents.
issues.recommendation: Add a single descriptive H1 heading containing the primary search query.

issues.title: Canonical Tag Missing
issues.description: No <link rel="canonical"> specified to declare the master version of this URL.
issues.impact: Risk of duplicate content penalties if URLs have query parameters or trailing slashes.
issues.recommendation: Add canonical link tag in the document <head>.

issues.title: No FAQ Schema Markup Detected
issues.description: Answer engines like Google SGE, Perplexity, and Siri rely on FAQ markup to deliver direct voice responses.
issues.impact: Loses top-of-SERP answer boxes and voice assistant citations.
issues.recommendation: Add FAQ Schema JSON-LD with common user queries and concise direct answers.
issues.codeSnippet:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What is CrawlLens?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "CrawlLens is an advanced multi-dimensional website audit engine covering SEO, AEO, AIO, GEO, and E-E-A-T."
    }
  }]
}
</script>

issues.title: Few Question-Based Headings
issues.description: Most headings are purely topical rather than structured as explicit questions.
issues.impact: Answer engines struggle to pair user voice prompts with your answers.
issues.recommendation: Convert key subheadings into natural conversational questions like "How does X work?".

issues.title: Low Ordered / Bulleted List Usage
issues.description: Found minimal structured list elements (<ul>, <ol>). Answer engines prefer listicles for process steps.
issues.impact: Decreased eligibility for bulleted carousel answer cards.
issues.recommendation: Format step-by-step instructions and feature comparisons into ordered or unordered lists.

issues.title: AI Crawlers Allowed & Indexable
issues.description: Robots meta permits full indexing by GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.
issues.impact: Enables your brand to be cited in generative answers and AI chat engines.
issues.recommendation: Maintain explicit allow directives in your robots.txt.

issues.title: Low Text Density for LLM Synthesis
issues.description: Only 25 words detected. AI models require contextual depth to reliably cite your page as a primary source.
issues.impact: Likely to be ignored during AI retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.
issues.recommendation: Expand comprehensive coverage with detailed explanations, technical definitions, and real data points.

issues.title: No JSON-LD Entity Signals
issues.description: Zero structured data schemas found. AI models use Knowledge Graph entities to connect facts to your brand.
issues.impact: Reduces entity disambiguation and authority recognition by AI search engines.
issues.recommendation: Add Organization, WebSite, or TechArticle schema markup.

issues.title: No Tabular Data Found
issues.description: Comparison tables and structured metrics are missing.
issues.impact: Generative search often synthesizes data from competing sites with clean tables.
issues.recommendation: Present key metrics, pricing, or feature comparisons in standard HTML <table> tags.

issues.title: Limited Quotable Soundbites
issues.description: Page lacks highlighted takeaway quotes, bold takeaways, or blockquotes.
issues.impact: Generative models prefer extracting punchy, high-confidence quotable summaries.
issues.recommendation: Highlight key takeaways with <blockquote> or callout summary cards.

issues.title: Incomplete Open Graph & Social Cards
issues.description: Missing og:image or twitter:card meta tags.
issues.impact: Reduces generative multimodal preview capabilities across AI platforms.
issues.recommendation: Add high-resolution og:image (1200x630) and twitter:card meta tags.

issues.title: Missing Author Byline / Expertise Badge
issues.description: No explicit author or reviewer attribution was identified in the content.
issues.impact: Fails Google Quality Rater guidelines for transparency, especially in YMYL topics.
issues.recommendation: Add an author byline with credentials, photo, and link to complete bio.
issues.codeSnippet: Written by John Doe, Technical SEO Lead

issues.title: Missing About Us or Direct Contact Information
issues.description: Could not find clear links to an About Us or Contact page.
issues.impact: Damages user trust signals and lowers site quality evaluations.
issues.recommendation: Ensure footer contains prominent links to About Us, Contact, and Support.

issues.title: Missing Privacy Policy Link
issues.description: No Privacy Policy or Terms of Service link detected in the DOM.
issues.impact: Violates GDPR/CCPA regulatory expectations and lowers baseline site credibility.
issues.recommendation: Add visible links to Privacy Policy and Terms of Use in footer.

summary.title: Example Domain - Official Documentation and Standard Reference
summary.metaDescription: Illustrative examples in documents without prior coordination. Used for documentation and testing purposes.

issues.title: Single Definitive H1 Heading
issues.description: The page correctly provides a single descriptive H1 heading: "Example Domain".
issues.impact: Establishes clear hierarchy for search crawlers.
issues.recommendation: Maintain strict single H1 structure.

issues.title: Missing FAQ Schema.org Structured Data
issues.description: No FAQPage schema found in JSON-LD markup.
issues.impact: Reduces snippet visibility in conversational search engines and Google SGE.
issues.recommendation: Add FAQ Schema to capture common user intent directly in voice search.

issues.title: Clean Semantic HTML for LLM Ingestion
issues.description: No obfuscated JavaScript or cloaked content. Text is cleanly formatted for AI agents.
issues.impact: Perplexity and ChatGPT Search can accurately retrieve and cite content fragments.
issues.recommendation: Keep DOM clean and semantic.

issues.title: Limited Tabular Comparison Data
issues.description: Generative search engines prefer comparison tables to synthesize answers.
issues.impact: Missing opportunities for generative matrix summaries.
issues.recommendation: Format feature lists or numerical data into HTML tables.

issues.title: Strong Organizational Authority
issues.description: Clear domain identity backed by IANA standards.
issues.impact: Highest possible domain trust rating.
issues.recommendation: Continue maintaining active SSL certificate.
